purpose: Requirements for document search: finding task-relevant documents from a ToC without false negatives, with a pre-search rebuild-necessity check and stale-ToC handling.
summary: FR-006 search requirement: return documents related to a task, prioritizing no omissions
Search targets the ToC given by --key, or the reserved key all in single mode when omitted
A missing ToC stops the search and reports that an initial build is required
An existing ToC is inspected for rebuild necessity before searching, using its stored target specification
When rebuild is needed the user chooses between rebuilding first or searching the existing ToC
The confirmation shows counts per change type and the number of documents needing AI summary generation
If necessity cannot be determined (permissions, read errors, unparsable spec), the search stops as a failure with the cause
Searching a stale ToC returns a notice that it may not reflect current targets and does not re-confirm the ToC
Search results include document ID, ToC path, reason for relevance, section, and ToC state
AC-019 acceptance criterion for the pre-search ToC rebuild confirmation
tasks: Designing search behavior and result format
Handling a missing ToC at search time
Implementing the rebuild-necessity check before search
Designing the rebuild confirmation prompt and its counts
Handling failures that prevent determining rebuild necessity
Searching with a stale ToC and notifying the user
Writing tests for search acceptance criteria AC-019
